title: A Plea to Return to the Lord

questions.question: Return, O Israel, to the Lord your God, for you have stumbled because of your what?
questions.explanation: Hosea 14:1 (ESV): "for you have stumbled because of your iniquity."

questions.question: Take with you what and return to the Lord?
questions.explanation: Hosea 14:2 (ESV): "Take with you words and return to the Lord;"

questions.question: Assyria shall not save us; we will not ride on what?
questions.explanation: Hosea 14:3 (ESV): "we will not ride on horses;"

questions.question: In you the orphan finds what?
questions.explanation: Hosea 14:3 (ESV): "In you the orphan finds mercy."

questions.question: I will heal their apostasy; I will love them freely, for my what has turned from them?
questions.explanation: Hosea 14:4 (ESV): "for my anger has turned from them."

questions.question: I will be like the dew to Israel; he shall blossom like the what?
questions.explanation: Hosea 14:5 (ESV): "he shall blossom like the lily;"

questions.question: He shall take root like the trees of where?
questions.explanation: Hosea 14:5 (ESV): "he shall take root like the trees of Lebanon."

questions.question: His shoots shall spread out; his beauty shall be like the what?
questions.explanation: Hosea 14:6 (ESV): "his beauty shall be like the olive,"

questions.question: They shall return and dwell beneath my shadow; they shall flourish like the what?
questions.explanation: Hosea 14:7 (ESV): "they shall flourish like the grain;"

questions.question: They shall blossom like the vine; their fame shall be like the wine of where?
questions.explanation: Hosea 14:7 (ESV): "their fame shall be like the wine of Lebanon."

questions.question: O Ephraim, what have I to do with idols? It is I who answer and look after you. I am like an evergreen what?
questions.explanation: Hosea 14:8 (ESV): "I am like an evergreen cypress; from me comes your fruit."

questions.question: Whoever is wise, let him understand these things; whoever is discerning, let him know them; for the ways of the Lord are what?
questions.explanation: Hosea 14:9 (ESV): "for the ways of the Lord are right,"

questions.question: And the upright walk in them, but transgressors do what in them?
We will say no more, "Our God," to the work of our what?
questions.explanation: Hosea 14:3 (ESV): "and we will say no more, 'Our God,' to the work of our hands."

key_verse_text: Whoever is wise, let him understand these things; whoever is discerning, let him know them; for the ways of the Lord are right, and the upright walk in them, but transgressors stumble in them.
